rationale.consistency: License headers, doc comments, nolint:bodyclose idiom, const block placement and handler registration all match Caddy; but the handler uses time.Duration instead of caddy.Duration for JSON fields, and `max` shadows the builtin.
rationale.edge_cases: Hard-deadline ceiling, negative-disables, NoBody, empty writes, zero-progress writes, chunk>0 and int overflow are handled; per-route handler skips the NoBody check and FlushError never refreshes the deadline.
rationale.scope: Touches exactly the files implied by the requirement; no unrelated refactors or dead code.
rationale.readability: Clear naming and structure; the MinRate credit/overflow arithmetic in next() is dense and would benefit from a simpler formulation or comment.
rationale.robustness: Nested route+server wrappers both set the same conn deadline and the server-level one runs last, so with the 1-minute default the per-route directive is effectively overridden; write deadlines also persist across keep-alive requests when WriteTimeout is 0. Hijack clears deadlines, good.
rationale.maintainability: Single IdleDeadline type shared by reader/writer and by server and handler avoids duplication; Caddyfile parse blocks mirror existing repetition; interaction between server and route wrappers is an undocumented coupling.
